title: MyoPath: A deep learning pipeline for objective morphometric assessment of skeletal muscle biopsies

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《MyoPath: A deep learning pipeline for objective morphometric assessment of skeletal muscle biopsies》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Introduction · p0030】Skeletal muscle biopsy is a standard part of the diagnostic workup for patients with neuromuscular symptoms1, 2, 3 and is increasingly used to monitor treatment response in clinical trials and to characterize muscle health in ageing and systemic disease. Interpreting these biopsies requires integrating histomorphological findings with clinical presentation, and the diagnostic yield depends on the specific clinical question.2 Pathological evaluation of hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained sections relies on qualitative descriptors such as “mild fiber size variation,” “occasional centralized nuclei,” and “moderate fatty replacement” that resist standardization across observers and institutions.1, 2, 3 Whereas pattern-based approaches to muscle biopsy interpretation have been well described,2 no internationally accepted quantitative grading system exists for H&E-based skeletal muscle pathology, in contrast to established grading systems in surgical pathology such as the Gleason system for prostatic adenocarcinoma.4

【Introduction · p0035】Quantitative measurements are needed for comparisons between patients and for evaluating treatment response. Histopathological endpoints are already used in muscular dystrophy studies,5, 6 whereas quantitative magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) can track muscle involvement.7, 8 In DM1, MRI fat fraction correlates with CTG repeat length and clinical severity scales.8 Histology provides complementary information at the fiber level, including nuclear position and variation in fiber size.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《MyoPath: A deep learning pipeline for objective morphometric assessment of skeletal muscle biopsies》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Study design · p0050】This retrospective, cross-sectional morphometric study analyzed H&E-stained skeletal muscle sections from two independent cohorts. The HuashanMuscle cohort was collected at Huashan Hospital, Fudan University, under institutional review board approval [IRB number 2022-913]. The GTEx cohort was accessed through the Genotype-Tissue Expression Project (dbGaP accession phs000424). All procedures conformed to the Declaration of Helsinki.

【HuashanMuscle clinical cohort · p0055】The cohort comprised 79 skeletal muscle biopsies from patients with genetically confirmed myopathies and controls with normal histopathology enrolled at Huashan Hospital, Fudan University, Shanghai, China (Table 1). Disease groups included DM1 (n = 28; 15 female; mean age 42.4 ± 10.7 years),18 LGMDR1 (calpainopathy, CAPN3 mutations; n = 12; 4 female; mean age 38.6 ± 13.3 years),19 LGMDR2 (dysferlinopathy, DYSF mutations; n = 22; 8 female; mean age 32.0 ± 11.6 years),20 and controls (n = 17; 10 female; mean age 41.2 ± 15.0 years). Controls underwent diagnostic biopsy for suspected neuromuscular disease but had no histopathological abnormalities; they were not healthy volunteers. LGMD nomenclature follows the reformed ENMC classification.21 Clinical data included CTG repeat count (DM1, n = 20), grip strength and 10-m walk time (DM1, n = 12 each), and mutation classification for LGMD.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《MyoPath: A deep learning pipeline for objective morphometric assessment of skeletal muscle biopsies》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Segmentation performance · p0190】MyoPath processed all 478 images. In the representative HuashanMuscle ROI (HE_M3807), it delineated 953 myofibers, 52 fat regions, and 1626 nuclei (Fig. 2A). Dice coefficients were 0.92 ± 0.03 for myofibers, 0.95 ± 0.02 for fat, 0.87 ± 0.04 for nuclei, and 0.88 ± 0.04 for connective tissue (Fig. 2B; Table 2). Automated fat and fibrosis measurements correlated with pathologist assessment (rho = 0.989 and 0.946; Fig. 2C). ICCs against the two pathologists were 0.93/0.93 for NCI, 0.93/0.92 for fiber CV, 0.99/0.98 for fat, 0.92/0.89 for fibrosis, and 0.98/0.98 for nuclear/muscle ratio. Shape regularity showed lower agreement (0.27/0.43); connective nuclear density was not included. Mean within-sample CVs across five ROIs were 0.051, 0.054, 0.068, and 0.065 for NCI, fiber CV, fat, and fibrosis, respectively. Single-ROI fat estimates correlated weakly with the pathologists' whole-specimen estimates in 245 GTEx samples (rho = 0.105, 95% CI −0.03–0.23), indicating limited agreement across sampling scales.

【Discriminative performance of the 37 features · p0200】In HuashanMuscle, 15 of 37 features differed between controls and myopathies (unadjusted p < 0.05; Fig. 3B). Nuclear-position and cellularity measures ranked highest, including central ratio (AUC 0.91), peripheral ratio (0.88), and total nuclear count (0.88). Fiber CV had AUC 0.79. In GTEx, fiber size and nuclear position were more prominent (Fig. 3C): fiber area Q1 had AUC 0.75, and NCI and fiber CV both had AUC 0.74. Fat and fibrosis each had AUC 0.67. Nuclear/muscle ratio, with AUC 0.83 in HuashanMuscle, had AUC 0.50 in GTEx. The rankings therefore differed between the biopsy and autopsy settings.

sections.title: 图表阅读
sections.text:
《MyoPath: A deep learning pipeline for objective morphometric assessment of skeletal muscle biopsies》：图表的原始标题与说明。

【Fig. 1 · f0005】Fig. 1 MyoPath workflow. (A) H&E image with a 1500 × 1500 μm ROI (6000-μm perimeter); 478 images from two cohorts were processed. (B) Myofibers are segmented with Cellpose-SAM, fat with a pixel classifier and nuclei with watershed detection. The connective compartment is obtained by subtraction. (C) Seven pathology indicators summarize 37 extracted features. NCI and fiber CV are highlighted for their consistent cross-cohort discrimination.

【Fig. 2 · f0010】Fig. 2 Segmentation validation and observer agreement. (A) Representative sample (HE_M3807). Top row: original H&E image (left) and pathologist manual annotation with each myofiber in a unique color (right). Bottom row: whole-slide image with ROI location (left) and MyoPath automated segmentation (right). (B) Dice coefficients (top) and intersection-over-union (bottom) for four tissue layers (n = 30 annotated ROIs). Dashed lines indicate 0.85 (Dice) and 0.75 (IoU) thresholds. (C) Scatter plots comparing automated measurements with pathologist assessment for fat infiltration (Spearman r = 0.989, p < 0.0001) and fibrosis (r = 0.946, p < 0.0001). Identity lines shown.

【Fig. 3 · f0015】Fig. 3 Feature ranking across 37 morphometric features. (A) Representative segmentation results from each diagnostic group. (B) HuashanMuscle cohort: AUC values for discriminating controls from myopathies, ranked by discriminative power. (C) GTEx cohort: AUC values for discriminating healthy donors from those with wasting diseases. Significance: *p < 0.05, **p < 0.01, ***p < 0.001.

sections.title: 复现线索
sections.text:
《MyoPath: A deep learning pipeline for objective morphometric assessment of skeletal muscle biopsies》：复现时可直接核对的数据、软件或实现线索。

【Data availability · p0025】GTEx data are available through dbGaP (phs000424), with Hardy categories and pathology annotations in the public sample attributes. Supplementary Data 1 provides the full-precision fitted model, de-identified per-sample morphometric features and fixed-model scores for reproducing the main discrimination results. HuashanMuscle images and analysis results are available at https://myotoolkit.huashanmuscle.com. The image-analysis pipeline is available at https://github.com/Hirriririir/MyoPath. Additional data are available from the corresponding authors upon reasonable request.
